result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Licensee may terminate on 30 days’ written notice, receives a pro-rata refund of prepaid post-termination fees, pays no early-termination charge, and Licensor receives no convenience right during the committed term. The addition generally preserves the remaining commercial terms. However, allowing termination “in whole or in part” exceeds the playbook requirement and introduces ambiguity because partial termination scope, fee allocation, and operational consequences are not addressed. Removing “or in part” would make the revision more minimal and precise.
